PLATFORM-00 A-E supplies the shared cross-system chassis only: environment/roots, exact process ownership, evidence-bound support policy, authenticated artifact provenance and architecture-isolated worker routing. It does not claim any real platform package, plugin host or customer acceptance.
PLATFORM-00E is implemented on mergeable draft PR #39 head 087955688bc9e235d0979b082fbc5e21084da93a and is the exact APP-01A baseline. Hosted exact-head execution for that head is UNOBSERVED.
Global reselection chose APP-01 because PLATFORM-00 closure mechanically unblocked the application lifecycle and APP-01 directly unlocks UX-01 plus downstream AUDIO/Song consumer reachability.

APP-01A is the only active increment. It composes the real PLATFORM-00B per-profile lease with the real HeadquartersMemory composition root; it is not a mock lifecycle state machine, installer, updater or UI shell.
First launch acquires exact profile ownership and opens Headquarters once. A repeated launch through the same runtime returns ALREADY_RUNNING without another Headquarters open.

A second ApplicationRuntime in the exact same process returns REOPEN_EXISTING and must not open a second Headquarters. Foreign ALIVE ownership is HELD_BY_OTHER and UNKNOWN liveness is UNCERTAIN; neither may be stolen.
Verified-dead ownership may be replaced only through PLATFORM-00B takeover semantics. The previous lease remains explicit evidence rather than disappearing from history.
If Headquarters open fails, APP-01A releases the just-acquired lease. If that cleanup also fails, the runtime enters RECOVERY_REQUIRED with exact lease ownership retained for explicit recovery.
Explicit quit closes Headquarters before releasing the exact lease. Close failure or lease-release failure stays RECOVERY_REQUIRED and never masquerades as STOPPED.
Successful quit reaches STOPPED and permits clean relaunch. The active increment must prove a real Song survives quit/relaunch through the canonical Headquarters database.
